description: Ten Milldale memory notes. Two carry deliberately lazy hooks (town-history: 'assorted notes'; civic-record: 'more notes') - the patients this loop exists to repair. Tasks come in PAIRS of phrasings: repair_visible (the loop may see its failures) and held_out (sealed before generation zero; the measurement). Ground-truth 'relevant' names the target note.

notes.name: bakery-hours
notes.hook: Opening hours for the Milldale bakery on Main Street
notes.body:
Opens 7am weekdays at 21 Main Street.
Closes 3pm. Saturday: 8am to 1pm.

notes.name: bike-repair
notes.hook: The bike shop on Forge Alley: services and turnaround
notes.body:
Repairs with a two-day turnaround on Forge Alley.
Tubes and brake work done same day.

notes.name: bus-route-7
notes.body: Route 7 hourly from the square, 7am to 9pm.

notes.name: clinic-hours
notes.hook: Hours for the Milldale walk-in clinic

notes.name: farmers-market
notes.hook: The Saturday farmers market on the town square
notes.body:
Saturdays 8am to noon on the square.
Produce, bread, and cider stalls.

notes.name: harvest-festival
notes.hook: The autumn harvest festival: dates and events on the square
notes.body:
First weekend of the month, on the square.
Cider pressing and a lantern walk.

notes.name: library-card
notes.hook: How to get and renew a Milldale library card
notes.body:
Bring one piece of mail to the counter.
Renew every two years, free.

notes.name: riverside-park
notes.hook: The riverside park: picnic tables and walking trails
notes.body: Picnic tables by the water and two walking trails.

notes.name: town-history
notes.body: The old mill by the river was founded in 1851 by the Harlan family.

notes.name: civic-record
notes.body: The town charter was signed in 1863 at the first town hall.
